definition: Industrial dispute resolution follows a **multi-tier machinery**: negotiation → **conciliation** (Conciliation Officer) → optional/reference to **Industrial Tribunal / National Industrial Tribunal** (adjudication). Strikes and lock-outs are regulated during pendency. The goal is **industrial peace** with fair hearing; awards are binding subject to judicial review.
